source: AWS Terrain Tiles (Mapzen terrarium; SRTM/3DEP/NED blend), public dataset
projection: Web Mercator resampled to an equal lon/lat grid; north up

region.note: 8-bit + hillshade normalized to 0.3–99.7 percentile; raw terrarium has a few spike artifacts (clamp to min/max).

core15km.note: 8-bit + hillshade normalized to 0.3–99.7 percentile; raw terrarium has a few spike artifacts (clamp to min/max).
